 NBA: Philadelphia 76ers Look to Remain Undefeated in Matchup Against Bucks
 by Javier Perez Jimenez 
 October 24, 2026 
 written by Javier Perez Jimenez 
 Updated by Javier Perez Jimenez 
 October 24, 2026 
 9 
 Havana, October 24 (RHC) – The Philadelphia 76ers will look to remain undefeated today at the start of the American professional basketball (NBA) season as they face the Milwaukee Bucks.
 The 76ers remain undefeated in the tournament after dominating their first two matchups against the New York Knicks (106-100) and the Cleveland Cavaliers (114-106); tonight, they will look to extend their winning streak to three games. 
 For tonight’s contest, which will take place at the Wells Fargo Center in Philadelphia, both teams will have their full rosters available, with no players sidelined due to injury or suspension. 
 The home team’s key player is veteran forward LeBron James, who is averaging 15.5 points, 9 rebounds, 6 assists, and 2 steals per game this season. For the visitors, the standout performer is shooting guard Tyler Herro, who is averaging 29 points, 3.5 rebounds, and 6.5 assists per game. 
 Philadelphia currently sits in third place in the Eastern Conference, trailing the Atlanta Hawks and the Detroit Pistons, while Milwaukee—following two consecutive losses—finds itself at the very bottom of the overall NBA standings.
